title: Discourses of Epictetus
author: Epictetus
public_title: Do you stress over every setback?

sections.title: Story
sections.narration: You stress over every setback. Ancient Stoics taught that only your judgments, not events, control your peace. In 2003, Harvard researcher Richard Davidson studied mindfulness monks and measured about a 30% drop in stress responses. The result? Later meta‑analyses, like the 2010 University of Nevada review by Steven C. Hayes, found acceptance‑based therapy cuts anxiety by 45% across groups. So why do we still chase external approval? The answer: our brains cling to habit, not logic. That's it. So next time you feel upset, remember you stress over every setback.
